currentness_note: Current same-day repository evidence. UnifiedDB/EAP remains CANDIDATE/TESTING, not canonical architecture promotion.
finding: UnifiedDB already has an executable disposable, epoch/hash-bound Emergent Assembly Preprocessor that compiles bounded relational ActiveAssemblies from seed refs/query context with context-only authority and negative-space propagation guards. Existing synthetic measurements show microsecond-class compilation/update subpaths and approximately millisecond-class natural-language hybrid retrieval, suggesting a plausible low-overhead bridge from visual perceptual seeds into current associative memory.
why_interesting_for_target_architecture: If q23's MVC/Qwen visual fast path can produce reliable current UnifiedDB entity/state refs, those refs can seed EAP before full 4B language decoding. Frank could then receive current visual evidence plus a compact, provenance-bound relational memory slice as one multimodal cognitive input. This may transform UnifiedDB from post-hoc lookup into a perceptually triggered possibility preprocessor.
unresolved_uncertainty: No matched visual-to-EAP end-to-end Frank benchmark exists yet. The strongest risk is confirmation bias from wrong visual seeds; the strongest performance uncertainty is whether seed resolution/context injection erases nominal EAP micro-latency gains.
falsifier: QWEN_ONLY or QWEN_PLUS_DIRECT_MEMORY matches/beats visual-seeded EAP on correct decision cost and task success, or wrong/stale visual seeds cause unacceptable memory-induced perception/action errors under the proposed guards.
